info.title: VhyxVoid platform API
info.description: The dashboard's API, for scripts, CI and editors. Authenticate with an API key: `Authorization: Bearer <keyId>.<secret>`. A key acts in its own workspace, as the member who created it, and each route needs one scope. Each key may make a number of requests per minute (plan limit); every response carries X-RateLimit headers. Generated from the routes the API serves.

post.summary: Compare live traffic with a spec
post.description:

Needs the `specs:read` scope.

apiKey.description: An API key from the dashboard: the key ID, a dot, and the secret.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before trying again.

data.description: The result; its shape is in the route's description and the docs.

E400.description: The request is not valid; the message says why.

E401.description: The key is missing, wrong, revoked or expired, or this route needs a dashboard sign-in.

E403.description: The key lacks the route's scope, belongs to another workspace, or its creator is no longer a member.

E429.description: The key's requests-per-minute limit (or the per-address limit) was reached. Retry after Retry-After.
